pages.text: For some actions, an empty block influence can embed a reference to its own position in a contract. But it can often be useful to reference a position outside the diagram or even change that position on the fly. That's where Webs of Fate and Spindles come in.

pages.title: Webs of Fate
pages.text: A $(bold)Web of Fate$() is created by transfusing Fate spirits into a cobweb.$(br2)It can be placed in a block focus of a contract diagram, anywhere that defines a position. For instance, a Web of Fate could influence a "go" action.
Spindles can be crafted and infused with color spirits to change their color. Using a spindle on a Web of Fate will turn the web the same color as the spindle.

When you make a contract using a Web of Fate, you will see a variable (your name + the web's color) instead of a location.$(br2)You can use a spindle of that color on a block to update that location whenever you want, or use it on air to clear the location. Your Sight will reveal all the locations you've set.
Shift-clicking a Web of Fate with a spindle will instead bake the spindle's $(italic)current$() target into the Web. This position will not be updated when you use the spindle.
